links.outcome: Anticoagulation quality (TTR, time in target INR) and adverse events, AI-WAR vs conventional management
links.effect: Median TTR 48.7% vs 81.3% (P<0.001); time in target INR 36.3% vs 61.9% (P<0.001); elevated INR 12.0% vs 16.8%; adverse events 9.6% vs 19.7% (P<0.001).
links.quote: Compared with conventional management, AI-WAR significantly improved median TTR (48.7% vs. 81.3%, P < 0.001), increased time in target INR (36.3% vs. 61.9%, P < 0.001), and reduced both elevated INR percentage (12.0% vs. 16.8%) and overall adverse event rate (9.6% vs. 19.7%, P < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Remote follow-up combined with systematic data management and AI dosing support for warfarin management in primary care
Bidirectional LSTM versus LSTM model architecture comparison for dose prediction

screen.reason: Evaluates a clinical decision support system (AI-WAR) using an LSTM model for warfarin dosing in a prospective cohort comparing clinical outcomes (TTR, adverse events) to conventional care, but evaluates the system itself rather than comparing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
